title: Oozing Venezuelan Beef Broth
description: A rich, fermented beef broth with smoky undertones, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Place beef chunks in a large pot and cover with 12 cups of cold water.
Add salt, peppercorns, bay leaves, garlic, onion, and cinnamon, then bring to a gentle boil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours, skimming foam as needed.
After simmering, strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve and return the liquid to the pot.
Add smoked paprika, fermented soy sauce, and lime juice, stirring until dissolved.
Increase heat to high, bring broth to a rolling boil, and let it simmer for an additional 20 minutes.
While the broth is still hot, pour it over a sheet of aluminum foil and lightly sprinkle with wood chips, then cover with a cloth to create a smoke chamber.
Let the broth rest, covered, at room temperature for 12 hours to allow gentle fermentation and smoky flavor infusion.
After fermentation, strain the broth again to remove solids, then reheat to a gentle simmer.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or lime as desired.
Ladle the broth into bowls, garnish with fresh cilantro, sliced red chilies, and a squeeze of lime.
Serve hot, optionally with a side of warm corn tortillas or rice.
